scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix photos/web && node scripts/prepare-env.js
scripts.dev:photos:api: node scripts/ensure-api.js && docker compose --env-file project.env up -d --no-deps api
scripts.dev:stack: node scripts/check-dev-ports.js && concurrently -n api,photos,gateway -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:photos:api" "npm run dev:photos:web" "npm run dev:gateway"
scripts.dev:all: node scripts/check-dev-ports.js && concurrently -n api,photos,studio,gateway -c yellow,cyan,blue,magenta "npm run dev:photos:api" "npm run dev:photos:web" "npm run dev:studio" "npm run dev:gateway"
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-remotion-content-length.js && node scripts/patch-remotion-node-env.js && node scripts/patch-remotion-process-update.js && node scripts/patch-remotion-index-html.js
